title: If I had to make ₹10 Lakh in 30 days with nothing but Claude Code, this is the plan I would run
description:
If I had to make ten lakh rupees in thirty days with nothing but Claude Code, this is the exact plan I would run, and it works on businesses in your own city.

Three steps. Step one, connect the Apify MCP to Claude Code and run the Google Maps scraper: every local business with phone numbers, websites and contacts lands in one spreadsheet. Step two, filter for the ones with no website or a dying one (no mobile version, no SSL, last updated years ago), paste their URL into Claude Code and ask for a premium redesign, you get a watermarked demo site in minutes. Step three, send that demo in a cold email. Not a pitch deck, the finished thing. The full site sells at fifty thousand to one lakh rupees.

Honest part: the AI does the demos in minutes. The money comes from sending fifty cold emails and hearing no forty times, and most people quit at the outreach, not the build. Apify also isn't free at volume.

Comment BUSINESS and I'll send you the full workflow.
